column2: Turns traction control off. Ride gently on wet or loose ground until you know how it behaves.
column3: Dit zet de tractiecontrole uit. Rijd rustig op natte of losse ondergrond tot je weet hoe de step zich gedraagt.
column4: This turns off the traction control. Ride calmly on wet or loose surfaces until you know how the scooter behaves.

column2: Below 3 km/h, the motor can pull from a standstill as soon as you use the throttle.
column3: Onder 3 km/h kan de step vanuit stilstand optrekken zodra je de gashendel gebruikt.
column4: Below 3 km/h the scooter can pull away from standstill as soon as you use the throttle lever.

column2: Turns motor braking off, so your brakes do more of the stopping.
column3: Dit zet de energieterugwinning (remmen met de motor) uit, dus je remmen moeten meer doen om te stoppen.
column4: This turns off the energy recovery (braking with the motor), so your brakes have to do more to stop.

column2: Caps your speed while riding, below your Top speed setting. Set back restores your previous setting.
column3: Dit begrenst je snelheid tijdens het rijden tot onder je instelling ‘Topsnelheid’. ‘Terugzetten’ herstelt je vorige instelling.
column4: This limits your speed while riding to below your ‘Top speed’ setting. ‘Reset’ restores your previous setting.
